#绘制直方图代码
```{r}
length<-c(1,1,1,2,3,4,4,5,5,6,6,7,7,2,2,2,2,4,4,5,6,7,3)
par(mfrow=c(1,3))
#选择不同带宽
h1<-hist(length,breaks = 0:35*0.75,freq=F,xlab="Bodysize",main = "bandwidth=0.75")
h2<-hist(length,breaks = 0:7*4,freq=F,xlab="Bodysize",main = "bandwidth=0.75")
h3<-hist(length,breaks = 0:3*10,freq=F,xlab="Bodysize",main = "bandwidth=0.75")
```

如果需要调用密度，只需要返回density，这是一个向量，输出的结果是每个bin的高度，也就是$\hat{f}(x)$
```{r}
#密度调用
h1$density
```


#核密度估计

```{r}
length<-c(1,1,1,2,3,4,4,5,5,6,6,7,7,2,2,2,2,4,4,5,6,7,3)
plot(density(length, kernel = "gaussian", bw = 1),
     main = "bandwidth = 1")

plot(density(length, kernel = "gaussian", bw = 2),
     main = "bandwidth = 2")

plot(density(length, kernel = "gaussian", bw = 8),
     main = "bandwidth = 8")

#常见核函数名称
#parzen窗(uniform)
#三角triangle
#Epanechikov
#四次(Quartic)
#三权(Triweight)
#高斯(Guass)
#余弦
#指数
```

#核密度估计加调用密度值的语法

```{r}
x <- c(1,1,1,2,3,4,4,5,5,6,6,7,7,2,2,2,2,4,4,5,6,7,3)

#调用核函数
d_gauss <- density(x, kernel = "gaussian", bw = 1)
d_epa   <- density(x, kernel = "epanechnikov", bw = 1)
d_rect  <- density(x, kernel = "rectangular", bw = 1)
d_tri   <- density(x, kernel = "triangular", bw = 1)
d_biw   <- density(x, kernel = "biweight", bw = 1)
d_cos   <- density(x, kernel = "cosine", bw = 1)

#画图
plot(d_gauss, lwd = 2)
lines(d_epa, lwd = 2, lty = 2)
lines(d_rect, lwd = 2, lty = 3)
lines(d_tri, lwd = 2, lty = 4)
lines(d_biw, lwd = 2, lty = 5)
lines(d_cos, lwd = 2, lty = 6)

```
先选一个区间

[min⁡𝑋−𝑐ℎ,max𝑋+𝑐ℎ]

[minX−ch,maxX+ch](c=3 默认)

在这个区间上取𝑛=512个等距网格点按照核密度公式计算密度，连成曲线

```{r}
d_gauss$x   # x 网格
d_gauss$y   # 在这些点上的密度
```

#得到点的精确核密度估计值
```{r}
#以指数核为例
exp_kernel <- function(u) 0.5 * exp(-abs(u))

kde_exp <- function(x0, data, h) {
  mean(exp_kernel((x0 - data)/h)) / h
}

kde_exp(3.5, x, h = 1)

#以三权核为例
triweight_kernel <- function(u) {
  ifelse(abs(u) <= 1, 35/32 * (1 - u^2)^3, 0)
}

kde_triweight <- function(x0, data, h) {
  mean(triweight_kernel((x0 - data)/h)) / h
}

kde_triweight(3.5, x, h = 1)

#parzen窗
uniform_kernel <- function(u) {
  ifelse(abs(u) <= 1, 0.5, 0)
}

kde_uniform <- function(x0, data, h) {
  mean(uniform_kernel((x0 - data)/h)) / h
}

kde_uniform(3.5, x, h = 1)

#三角核
triangular_kernel <- function(u) {
  ifelse(abs(u) <= 1, 1 - abs(u), 0)
}

kde_triangular <- function(x0, data, h) {
  mean(triangular_kernel((x0 - data)/h)) / h
}

kde_triangular(3.5, x, h = 1)

#Epanechnikov核
epanechnikov_kernel <- function(u) {
  ifelse(abs(u) <= 1, 0.75 * (1 - u^2), 0)
}

kde_epanechnikov <- function(x0, data, h) {
  mean(epanechnikov_kernel((x0 - data)/h)) / h
}

kde_epanechnikov(3.5, x, h = 1)

#四次核
quartic_kernel <- function(u) {
  ifelse(abs(u) <= 1, 15/16 * (1 - u^2)^2, 0)
}

kde_quartic <- function(x0, data, h) {
  mean(quartic_kernel((x0 - data)/h)) / h
}

kde_quartic(3.5, x, h = 1)

#高斯核
gaussian_kernel <- function(u) {
  dnorm(u)
}

kde_gaussian <- function(x0, data, h) {
  mean(gaussian_kernel((x0 - data)/h)) / h
}

kde_gaussian(3.5, x, h = 1)

#余弦和
cosine_kernel <- function(u) {
  ifelse(abs(u) <= 1, pi/4 * cos(pi * u / 2), 0)
}

kde_cosine <- function(x0, data, h) {
  mean(cosine_kernel((x0 - data)/h)) / h
}

kde_cosine(3.5, x, h = 1)
```

#核密度估计置信区间代码
```{r}
# =========================
# 常见核函数（已归一化）
# =========================

kernel_list <- list(

  uniform = function(u) {
    ifelse(abs(u) <= 1, 0.5, 0)
  },

  triangle = function(u) {
    ifelse(abs(u) <= 1, 1 - abs(u), 0)
  },

  epanechnikov = function(u) {
    ifelse(abs(u) <= 1, 3/4 * (1 - u^2), 0)
  },

  quartic = function(u) {
    ifelse(abs(u) <= 1, 15/16 * (1 - u^2)^2, 0)
  },

  triweight = function(u) {
    ifelse(abs(u) <= 1, 35/32 * (1 - u^2)^3, 0)
  },

  gaussian = function(u) {
    dnorm(u)
  },

  cosine = function(u) {
    ifelse(abs(u) <= 1, pi/4 * cos(pi * u / 2), 0)
  },

  exponential = function(u) {
    0.5 * exp(-abs(u))
  }
)

kde_general <- function(x0, data, h, kernel) {
  mean(kernel((x0 - data) / h)) / h
}

kde_bootstrap_band <- function(
  data,
  kernel = c("gaussian", "epanechnikov", "triweight",
             "quartic", "triangle", "uniform",
             "cosine", "exponential"),
  h,
  grid_length = 512,
  B = 500,
  alpha = 0.05,
  seed = NULL
) {

  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)

  kernel_name <- match.arg(kernel)
  K <- kernel_list[[kernel_name]]

  n <- length(data)

  # =========================
  # 网格
  # =========================
  grid <- seq(min(data) - 3*h,
              max(data) + 3*h,
              length.out = grid_length)

  # =========================
  # 原始 KDE
  # =========================
  p_hat <- sapply(grid, kde_general,
                  data = data, h = h, kernel = K)

  # =========================
  # Bootstrap
  # =========================
  R_vals <- numeric(B)

  for (b in 1:B) {
    data_star <- sample(data, replace = TRUE)

    p_hat_star <- sapply(grid, kde_general,
                         data = data_star, h = h, kernel = K)

    R_vals[b] <- sqrt(n * h) * max(abs(p_hat - p_hat_star))
  }

  # =========================
  # 分位数
  # =========================
  z_alpha <- quantile(R_vals, probs = 1 - alpha)

  # =========================
  # 置信带
  # =========================
  lower <- p_hat - z_alpha / sqrt(n * h)
  upper <- p_hat + z_alpha / sqrt(n * h)

  # =========================
  # 输出
  # =========================
  list(
    grid = grid,
    density = p_hat,
    lower = lower,
    upper = upper,
    z_alpha = z_alpha,
    kernel = kernel_name,
    h = h,
    alpha = alpha
  )
}

```

调用示例
```{r}
set.seed(123)
x <- rnorm(200)

res <- kde_bootstrap_band(
  data = x,
  kernel = "gaussian",
  h = 0.4,
  B = 300,
  seed = 1
)

```

#多维核密度函数调用
```{r}
# ===============================
# 多维核函数
# ===============================

# 1. n维高斯核
gaussian_kernel_nd <- function(x) {
  d <- length(x)
  (2 * pi)^(-d/2) * exp(-0.5 * sum(x^2))
}

# 2. n维球形核 K(x) = 3/pi * (1 - x^T x) * I(x^T x < 1)
sphere_kernel <- function(x) {
  r2 <- sum(x^2)
  if (r2 < 1) return(3/pi * (1 - r2)) else return(0)
}

# 3. n维球形核 K(x) = 4/pi * (1 - x^T x)^3 * I(x^T x < 1)
sphere_kernel3 <- function(x) {
  r2 <- sum(x^2)
  if (r2 < 1) return(4/pi * (1 - r2)^3) else return(0)
}

# 4. 多维Epanechnikov核 K_e(x) = 1/2 c_d^{-1} (d+2) (1 - x^T x) I(x^T x < 1)
epanechnikov_kernel <- function(x) {
  d <- length(x)
  c_d <- pi^(d/2) / gamma(d/2 + 1)  # 单位球体体积
  r2 <- sum(x^2)
  if (r2 < 1) return(0.5 * (d + 2) / c_d * (1 - r2)) else return(0)
}

# ===============================
# 多维KDE函数
# ===============================
kde_nd <- function(x0, data, h, kernel = "gaussian") {
  # x0: 目标点向量
  # data: n x d 矩阵，每行是一个样本
  # h: 带宽向量或标量
  # kernel: "gaussian", "sphere", "sphere3", "epanechnikov"
  
  n <- nrow(data)
  d <- ncol(data)
  
  if (length(h) == 1) h <- rep(h, d)  # 如果是标量带宽，扩展为向量
  if (length(h) != d) stop("带宽向量长度必须等于维度数")
  
  # 选择核函数
  ker_fun <- switch(kernel,
                    gaussian = gaussian_kernel_nd,
                    sphere = sphere_kernel,
                    sphere3 = sphere_kernel3,
                    epanechnikov = epanechnikov_kernel,
                    stop("未知核函数"))
  
  # 计算KDE
  kde_vals <- numeric(n)
  for (i in 1:n) {
    u <- (x0 - data[i, ]) / h
    kde_vals[i] <- ker_fun(u)
  }
  
  # 多维带宽归一化
  prod_h <- prod(h)
  mean(kde_vals) / prod_h
}

# ===============================
# 示例使用(输入是一个矩阵)
# ===============================
set.seed(1)
x <- matrix(rnorm(50*2), ncol = 2)  # 50个二维样本
x0 <- c(0.5, -0.2)
h <- c(0.8, 0.8)

kde_nd(x0, x, h, kernel = "gaussian")
kde_nd(x0, x, h, kernel = "epanechnikov")
kde_nd(x0, x, h, kernel = "sphere")
kde_nd(x0, x, h, kernel = "sphere3")

```

#贝叶斯分类决策和非参数核密度估计
```{r}
#类别i 从1到n
#每一个类别有一个向量
#根据向量得到属于每个类别的频率得到先验密度p(θi)
#使用核密度估计得到在该类别下的条件密度函数P(x|θi)
#计算p(x|θi)p(θi)
#θ^*=argmax{p(x|θi)p(θi}

# ===============================
# 一维高斯核
# ===============================
gaussian_kernel <- function(u) {
  dnorm(u)
}

# ===============================
# 多维高斯KDE
# ===============================
kde_gaussian_nd <- function(x0, data, h) {
  # x0: 目标点向量 (1xd)
  # data: n x d 矩阵，每行一个样本
  # h: 带宽向量或标量
  n <- nrow(data)
  d <- ncol(data)
  
  if (length(h) == 1) h <- rep(h, d)
  if (length(h) != d) stop("带宽向量长度必须等于维度数")
  
  kde_vals <- numeric(n)
  for (i in 1:n) {
    u <- (x0 - data[i, ]) / h
    kde_vals[i] <- prod(gaussian_kernel(u))  # 高斯核多维独立假设
  }
  
  mean(kde_vals) / prod(h)
}

# ===============================
# 贝叶斯分类器（非参数KDE）
# ===============================
bayes_kde_classifier <- function(x_new, data_list, h) {
  # x_new: 待分类样本 (向量)
  # data_list: list，每个元素是一个类别的样本矩阵
  # h: 带宽标量或向量
  n_class <- length(data_list)
  
  post_vals <- numeric(n_class)
  
  for (i in 1:n_class) {
    data_i <- data_list[[i]]
    prior_i <- nrow(data_i) / sum(sapply(data_list, nrow))  # 先验p(theta_i)
    cond_density <- kde_gaussian_nd(x_new, data_i, h)        # p(x|theta_i)
    post_vals[i] <- cond_density * prior_i                  # 后验值 p(x|theta_i)p(theta_i)
  }
  
  # 分类结果
  class_hat <- which.max(post_vals)
  return(list(class = class_hat, posterior = post_vals))
}

# ===============================
# 示例使用
# ===============================
set.seed(123)
# 构造两个类别样本
class1 <- matrix(rnorm(20*2, mean = 0), ncol = 2)
class2 <- matrix(rnorm(20*2, mean = 3), ncol = 2)

data_list <- list(class1, class2)

# 待分类点
x_new <- c(1, 0.5)
h <- c(1, 1)

result <- bayes_kde_classifier(x_new, data_list, h)
print(result)

```

批量输入数据自动选最优带宽版本
```{r}
# ===============================
# 一维高斯核
# ===============================
gaussian_kernel <- function(u) {
  dnorm(u)
}

# ===============================
# 多维高斯KDE
# ===============================
kde_gaussian_nd <- function(x0, data, h) {
  # x0: 待估计点，1xd 向量
  # data: n x d 样本矩阵
  # h: 带宽向量或标量
  n <- nrow(data)
  d <- ncol(data)
  
  if (length(h) == 1) h <- rep(h, d)
  if (length(h) != d) stop("带宽向量长度必须等于维度数")
  
  # 高斯核乘积公式
  kde_vals <- apply(data, 1, function(row) {
    prod(gaussian_kernel((x0 - row) / h))
  })
  
  mean(kde_vals) / prod(h)
}

# ===============================
# 自动带宽选择（Silverman规则扩展到多维）
# ===============================
auto_bandwidth <- function(data) {
  d <- ncol(data)
  h <- numeric(d)
  for (j in 1:d) {
    # Silverman rule: 1.06*sd*n^(-1/5)
    h[j] <- 1.06 * sd(data[,j]) * nrow(data)^(-1/5)
  }
  return(h)
}

# ===============================
# 批量贝叶斯KDE分类器
# ===============================
bayes_kde_classifier_batch <- function(X_new, data_list, h_list = NULL) {
  # X_new: 待分类样本矩阵，每行一个样本
  # data_list: list，每个元素是类别样本矩阵
  # h_list: list，每个类别的带宽向量，如果为NULL自动选择
  
  n_class <- length(data_list)
  n_new <- nrow(X_new)
  
  # 自动选择带宽
  if (is.null(h_list)) {
    h_list <- lapply(data_list, auto_bandwidth)
  }
  
  # 保存分类结果和后验概率
  class_hat <- integer(n_new)
  posterior_list <- vector("list", n_new)
  
  for (i in 1:n_new) {
    x0 <- X_new[i, ]
    post_vals <- numeric(n_class)
    
    for (c in 1:n_class) {
      data_c <- data_list[[c]]
      prior_c <- nrow(data_c) / sum(sapply(data_list, nrow))
      cond_density <- kde_gaussian_nd(x0, data_c, h_list[[c]])
      post_vals[c] <- cond_density * prior_c
    }
    
    class_hat[i] <- which.max(post_vals)
    posterior_list[[i]] <- post_vals
  }
  
  return(list(class = class_hat, posterior = posterior_list))
}

# ===============================
# 示例使用
# ===============================
set.seed(123)
# 构造两个类别样本
class1 <- matrix(rnorm(20*2, mean = 0), ncol = 2)
class2 <- matrix(rnorm(20*2, mean = 3), ncol = 2)
data_list <- list(class1, class2)

# 批量待分类点
X_new <- matrix(c(1,0.5, 2,2, 0,1), ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE)

# 调用批量分类器
result <- bayes_kde_classifier_batch(X_new, data_list)
print(result$class)      # 分类结果
print(result$posterior)  # 每个样本的后验概率

```

#k近邻估计(获取密度)
```{r}
library("FNN")

knn_density <- function(x0, data, k) {
  n <- nrow(data)
  d <- ncol(data)
  
  # 找 x0 到数据集中 k 个最近邻的距离
  knn_dist <- get.knnx(data, t(as.matrix(x0)), k)$nn.dist
  
  R_k <- knn_dist[k]  # 第 k 个最近邻距离
  
  # 单位球体体积
  V_d <- pi^(d/2) / gamma(d/2 + 1)
  
  density_est <- k / (n * V_d * R_k^d)
  return(density_est)
}

# ===============================
# 示例使用
# ===============================
set.seed(1)
data <- matrix(rnorm(50*2), ncol=2)  # 50个二维样本
x0 <- c(0,0)
k <- 5

knn_density(x0, data, k)

```

#k近邻分类
```{r}
library(class)

# 构造示例数据
set.seed(1)
#rnorm(20*2,0), ncol=2 生成40个随机数排成两列 相当于协方差为0均值为0的联合正态分布
train <- rbind(matrix(rnorm(20*2,0), ncol=2), matrix(rnorm(20*2,3), ncol=2))
train_labels <- c(rep(1,20), rep(2,20))

test <- matrix(c(1,0.5, 2,2), ncol=2, byrow=TRUE)

# kNN 分类
pred <- knn(train=train, test=test, cl=train_labels, k=5)
pred
```

kNN 分类的核心思想：

对于一个待分类的样本 𝑥，找训练集中距离 x 最近的 k 个点，然后让这个点的类别“投票”，选票最多的类别就是 x 的预测类别。
